subject: Quick fit check + demo slot proposal for your self‑signup
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Sophie Park <sophie@tailwind.ai>
Date: 2027-06-21T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Quick follow on your signup — a few fit questions

Hi Sophie,

Thanks for signing up with Redwood Inference — I'm Rishi on the SDR team and I help get self‑serve signups set up with a short pilot/demo. Before we lock a 30–45min session, two quick fit questions so we tailor the run: 

• Primary use case: are you focused on chat UX, retrieval/semantic search, classification, or batch embeddings?
• Expected qps/throughput: what are typical+peak requests per minute (or per hour) for the initial pilot?
• Typical sequence length and expected avg token length (rough ballpark is fine).
• Concurrency: how many simultaneous users / worker threads will be hitting the model in peak?
• Timeline: are you looking to run a 2–4 week pilot, or something shorter/longer?
• Any data sensitivity (PII/PHI) or regulatory constraints we should flag for VPC options?

If you can reply with the bullets above I’ll propose three morning slots (your timezone) and pull in our solutions engineer if needed. I attached a short pre-demo checklist that helps us size the environment — one-pager.

Attachments: pre-demo-checklist.pdf (1 page)

Thanks — talk soon,

Rishi Malhotra
SDR, Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555‑0198

From: Sophie Park <sophie@tailwind.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Huang <marcus@tracecart.co>
Date: 2027-06-21T12:42:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Quick follow on your signup — a few fit questions

Hi Rishi — thanks for the quick note. Answers below: 

• Use case: customer support chatbot + reranking for short doc search (hybrid retrieval + generation).
• Expected throughput: pilot ~150–300 requests/minute typical, spikes up to ~1,000 rpm (brief).
• Sequence length: avg ~120 tokens, peaks ~600 tokens.
• Concurrency: we expect 6–10 concurrent agents hitting endpoints during peak.
• Timeline: hoping to run a 3‑week pilot starting early July, with a go/no‑go decision after that window.
• Data sensitivity: mostly support logs, no PHI; we prefer data not leave our tenant (so private deployment info is relevant).

We are on Eastern time (EDT / UTC‑4). Morning slots work best for Sophie/Marcus (9–11am EDT).

— Sophie
Sophie Park
Head of Product, Tailwind AI
sophie@tailwind.ai

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>

Date: 2027-06-21T14:05:00-07:00

Thanks Sophie — that's super helpful. Based on the numbers you gave (150–1,000 rpm, 6–10 concurrent agents, avg 120 tokens) we’ll size a pilot around a dedicated slot with autoscaling headroom; Monica (cc'd), our onboarding engineer, will scope the backend details on the call.

Proposing three 45‑minute windows (all in EDT as requested):
• Thu 2027‑06‑24 — 09:30–10:15 EDT
• Fri 2027‑06‑25 — 10:00–10:45 EDT
• Mon 2027‑06‑28 — 09:00–09:45 EDT

If any of these work, pick one and I’ll send the calendar invite with a short agenda: 1) quick architecture + deployment options (hosted vs private), 2) sizing and cost estimates for the pilot, 3) success criteria and next steps.

Or you can book directly here: https://cal.com/rishi-ml/demo-45 (I left 3×45min slots labelled "TraceCart pilot")

I also attached a one‑tab pilot template to capture target queries, expected load windows, and sample prompts (pilot-template.xlsx). If you can prefill that ahead of the call it'll speed things up.

Attachments: pilot-template.xlsx

Best,
Rishi
SDR, Redwood Inference
